title: January 'whistle' event gets zero results; February whistle plus psionics gives first naked-eye UAP

tellings.quote: Hmm, let's move on to February. We spent event in January with equipment, but without" whistle ". And we got zero result.

plain: The team at Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, says that at a January 2025 event at its field site it brought its equipment but no "whistle", its name for a signal meant to call the objects, and got zero results. In February it used the whistle together with psionics, by which it means sending out signals with the mind, and the team says it saw its first UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomenon, the current term for a UFO) with the naked eye. The team tells Michels this as its own field results. If true, these objects would respond when called.
